spec_input:
Project Name: Sweet Serenity Bakery

Description: Build a gorgeous, modern React frontend for "Sweet Serenity Bakery."

Please create the following files inside src/:

App.js: The main entry point that renders all the sections below.
components/Hero.js: A full-width cinematic hero section with a bakery tagline and a "View Menu" call to action button.
components/FeaturedPastries.js: A responsive grid showcasing 3 signature pastries (e.g., Artisan Sourdough, Strawberry Tart, Chocolate Éclair).
components/AboutUs.js: A short, elegant section explaining the bakery's history and commitment to organic ingredients.
Technical Requirements:

Use modern React functional components exclusively (NO class components).
Use export default function ComponentName() syntax.
The UI should feel premium, so use beautiful inline styles or semantic HTML structure that can easily be styled later.
For images, use highly reliable placeholders like https://loremflickr.com/800/600/pastry or https://loremflickr.com/2000/1000/bakery.

specification.description: A modern React frontend for Sweet Serenity Bakery, showcasing the menu, about us, and other content.
acceptance_criteria: The Hero.js component displays a full-width cinematic hero section with a bakery tagline and a 'View Menu' call to action button.
The FeaturedPastries.js component displays a responsive grid showcasing 3 signature pastries with image placeholders.
